## Problem and Result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link any related issue.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain relevant skipped tests or
checks you could not run. For performance-sensitive changes, include comparable
before/after measurements and any OCR output differences. For OCR/RTL changes,
include a shareable input and unedited output example.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change follows CONTRIBUTING.md and the relevant project roadmap.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; Ruff check, Ruff format check, and ty check pass.
- [ ] Documentation, the Unreleased changelog, and TODO status are updated where applicable.
- [ ] Recognized words, Arabic/RTL behavior, and the Direct-RAM pipeline are preserved or intentional changes are explained.
- [ ] No secrets, private book pages, generated exports, or unrelated changes are included; new dependencies have license notes where applicable.
